label: The measured boilerplate flood is a blockquote, not prose: 783 of 787 rows for the stock sentence are the same blockquote line, with only 7 distinct line texts.
A body line class demotes the blockquote wall generically but cannot separate rows that share one class; it does not shrink the flood, which belongs to feature 3's per-file cap.
A second stock guidance sentence shows the same shape: 782 blockquote rows against 5 prose rows.
On the realistic query 'acceptance criteria', 9,418 body rows include 3,499 table rows but the first table appears at body position 371; path order, not evidence shape, decides the top 20.
The stock-sentence list is strictly narrower than a blockquote class: the one measured flood line is a blockquote, so a curated deny list adds drift with no measured extra coverage.

Template-folder demotion reaches 3 of 786 free-text paths (0.4%); the measured template inversion is on the keyed lane, where three template copies still take slots 3-5 of 6 and a fix needs a persisted judge class or a path policy.
No query log exists in the retrieval lane, so the build trigger must be a recorded reproducible query in a packet rather than a log entry.
The change is about 125 lines across one ranking function, one formatter, one contract section and one test file, with no new I/O, no schema bump and one caller.
Body class must be a pure function of the matched line text; no surrounding-line read, no file-state cache, no new I/O.
The rank tuple must stay deterministic: body class is a tie-break after match class and before path and line, so the path/line pair still breaks every remaining tie.
